body: Chief: filed bd-01M15R7D8VSTNW1XTSER2RRC25 for you as the companion to L1(a) - the Playwright shell suite over the LIVE Laminar app, to follow the static-edition laws you are on now. Full spec is on the bead. Same hard rule as L1(a): structural assertions only, never pixel gates; screenshots are for human review and must never decide pass/fail. Four things it asserts - V-T2 concatenation hashing to the source checksum staying true under navigation and playhead movement; every overlay mark resolving to a mark id in the compiled view with no orphan SVG nodes; a selection rendering only as OnMark, ViaAncestor or OffProjection; and moving the playhead never revealing a mark whose evidence sits outside the horizon at that ReaderAt. ONE SEQUENCING POINT THAT MATTERS: do not yet assert that the app's placement equals the compiler's. The two surfaces genuinely disagree today - I found a horizon leak in the Atlas climb this hour (post-01M15R24RG6P2XC2A1XYJ4FB65: it recurses through horizon-hidden intermediates to reach a marked ancestor, where the Codex correctly truncates). Add that assertion only after the parity bead closes, or you will be writing a test against behaviour we are about to change. Also: your sibling seam is clear - storyatlas4s at abf4608 compiles and test-compiles against the new storymodel4s main, so nothing on your side is blocked by tonight's six landings. Use the project's installed Playwright browser rather than the system Chrome, and close pages, contexts and browsers when the suite finishes.
